bluf: Digital Silk is a founder led premium web design agency in Miami, FL (founded 2018, 150+ team members) selling conversion focused custom sites, branding and supporting marketing to B2B, B2C and enterprise brands. It is riding a 2026-09 ranking, No. 23 on Newsweek and Statista's America's Most Reliable Companies 2026, and runs live ads (51 Google ads, 18 in the last 30 days; 24 LinkedIn company ads). The record points it at redesigns that lift leads. A rival should know the Horus read puts it Exposed at -16.5, it sells CRO with no testing tool on its own homepage, and 19 of 22 clients are names only.
doing:
The positioning line, a premium web design agency for B2B, B2C and enterprise brands building conversion focused custom sites, brand strategy and supporting digital marketing, decodes as a build shop: the website is the product, marketing the add on. The headline claim is the ranking, No. 23 on Newsweek and Statista's America's Most Reliable Companies 2026 and the list's top digital agency, quoted as the record quotes it; the homepage also cites DesignRush Best Digital Agency of 2025 and five star DesignRush reviews, and founder and CEO Gabriel Shaoolian is credited with Forbes and Entrepreneur columns and Bloomberg, Reuters and CNN appearances.

The sold mix leads with Web & Product, score 3: the title and H1 brand it a web design agency and its llms.txt calls web design the core offering. CRO is the second core line at score 2: the meta promises conversion focused sites and press cites conversion lifts for USA Roller Chain and Zywave. B2B & ABM, Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO score 1 each with no evidence note; AI automation, AI search, content and PR, creator, data, email, local, programmatic and retail media score 0. The twelve services run from digital strategy and brand identity through custom web, UX, eCommerce, Shopify and app development to B2B lead generation, SEO and social and paid media. The record lists no partners and no proprietary product.

AI posture: the record holds none, no AI service line and no statement, though the site publishes llms.txt and 4 AI topic URLs sit in the sitemap.

Moves: one, in 2026-09, the Newsweek and Statista No. 23 ranking. The record lists no news beyond the press pages, no case study titles, no jobs and no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for a web build agency of its size: any named platform partner (no Shopify partnership is listed although Shopify websites is a service), any measurement line, and any AI statement in 2026.
clients:
The ICP is mixed and ten verticals are listed, Legal, Healthcare, Hospitality and luxury, Real estate, Education, Financial services, Manufacturing and industrial, Ecommerce and retail, Entertainment and Technology; the home market is the US, with Miami, FL the only office.

The needs read holds 22 clients from case studies (15), case study slugs (4) and press releases (3); 3 are observed, 19 names only. AutogenAI came for a redesign, web build and platform with AI and automation (slug: autogen ai redesign); Zywave came for a website redesign a press release says drove a surge in lead submissions, web build with lead generation; Arizona Benefit Consultants came for a brand overhaul after 29 years, brand and creative. The mix reads web build and platform 0.373, AI and automation 0.267, brand and creative 0.24, leads 0.12. Pennsylvania Compensation Rating Bureau is coded N0 though its press release URL describes a redesigned platform launch. The rest are names only, need inferred as web build: RE/MAX Costa Rica, Northwestern Medill, TRC Healthcare, Bang & Olufsen, Spar & Bernstein, Acqualina Resort, Ventura Foods, Puma Energy, Toho International, VigilantIoE, National Aviation, Zorro Productions, Vacca Family Law Group, ABC Senior Services, and from slugs alone IBM, HP, Habitat for Humanity and Bethpage Federal Credit Union.

Two clients are shared: TRC Healthcare sits on seer-interactive's book and Bang & Olufsen on publicis-sapient's.

What the base needs next: the read places Digital Silk best for KJ2 on a Paid Search line scoring only 1, and most exposed to KJ4, the platforms are absorbing the execution layer. It is likely, moderate confidence, that these B2B and professional services buyers next want the redesign tied to measured lead flow, the Zywave pattern, and roughly an even chance they route the paid and SEO add ons elsewhere.
house: Say and do: one line tested. CRO is contradicted: it sells CRO and no testing tool is detected on its own homepage, the one gap the Radar lists. The tag stack shows gtm and hubspot on WordPress and Squarespace, with no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack. It publishes llms.txt and blocks no AI crawlers. market:
The Horus read scores Digital Silk at -16.5 on the tailwind index, Exposed band, percentile 4, with say/do integrity at 0 since its one tested line failed. It is best placed for KJ2, ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them (net 0.097, Paid Search), a weak tailwind on a line scoring 1. It is most exposed to KJ4, the platforms are absorbing the execution layer (net -0.389, Paid Search and Paid Social), and KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.225, Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO). The Monsoon read: index 65.8, Onshore wind band, percentile 84, migration 64.3 against displacement 67.3, inferred. The verdict says Web & Product (30) and CRO (11) carry the most movable hours and the shore split sends 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America; no hub office or onshore claim is listed.
openings:
Lead with the CRO contradiction: Digital Silk sells conversion focused sites and cites conversion lifts for USA Roller Chain and Zywave, while no testing tool is detected on its own homepage. A rival whose own site runs a visible testing program very likely, moderate confidence, wins the conversion argument. Falsifier: a testing tool appearing on digitalsilk.com.

Price is the second opening: displacement 67.3 on the Monsoon read says the book buys on price, and Web & Product carries 30 of the movable hours, so an offshore delivered rival can likely undercut it line by line, though the read is inferred from the sold mix, not an observed footprint. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) means a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public.

The contestable clients are the names only, 19 of 22, and the two shared ones, TRC Healthcare (seer-interactive) and Bang & Olufsen (publicis-sapient). The paid and SEO add ons, scoring 1 each, sit on the hours KJ4 removes, so a rival that pairs a redesign with feeds, schema and entity work (P2 absent) and an AI visibility line (P1 absent) likely takes the marketing spend while it keeps the build.
watch: Indicator I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, next reading December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV would deepen the KJ4 exposure of its eCommerce and Shopify build lines, while high Shopify opt out rates would slow it.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: pricing below $20 CPM would signal supply outrunning demand and thin the one KJ2 tailwind the read gives it.
Follow up the 2026-09 Newsweek and Statista ranking: a second dated move, a partner listing or a case study with described work would change the names only read of the book.
